title: Simplify Tactus smoke worker planning
description: The generic Tactus worker procedure fails before implementation because the separate planner agent triggers structured output validation. Simplify the smoke worker by making planning deterministic text and keeping the implementer as the only agent turn.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Kept the planner agent and made its contract explicit with structured output fields plan/files. The implementer now consumes planner.output.plan, preserving the multi-agent Tactus procedure shape.
